alt_text: Slide 1 of 6. Keep a record of what helped—not a score of how well you healed.
Slide 2 of 6. A simple note can reveal which options were useful on different kinds of days.
Slide 3 of 6. Write the situation, what you tried, and whether it helped a little, not at all, or made things harder.
Slide 4 of 6. Use the notes to choose future support, not to demand the same result every time.
Slide 5 of 6. Bring recurring difficulties to a qualified professional. A personal note is not a clinical assessment.
Slide 6 of 6. Save this idea for building a more realistic set of options over time.
